# Hypnotherapy Manchester

> > Professional hypnotherapy, psychotherapy, and clinical supervision services in Manchester and online, led by accredited practitioner Shaun Brookhouse since 1989.

Brookhouse Hypnotherapy Manchester offers evidence-based clinical hypnotherapy and psychotherapy for mental health conditions, behavioral issues, and personal development. Services include treatment for anxiety, depression, IBS, smoking cessation, weight management, and professional clinical supervision for therapists.
